title: Join actions on the same thing

do.text: Join actions that work on one object — a save and its menu, a stepper's minus and plus.

dont.text: Don't join actions that do unrelated things: people read a joined control as one choice.

do.text: Give every icon-only child a `label` that says what it does, so a screen reader names each one.

dont.text: Don't rely on the glyphs alone: "Button, button" tells a screen reader nothing.

do.text: Keep a joined row to a few buttons that fit the screen's width.

dont.text: Don't squeeze many buttons into one row: their labels truncate and their touch areas crowd each other.
